title: Samosa reign state diagram
description: Whether the President is still in office. playGame() sets alive or escaped and throws ReignOver to end the reign; a dead President gets the funeral screen, and every reign ends with the rating and the final report.
machine: GameState.alive and GameState.escaped (src/engine/state.ts), set by playGame (src/engine/flow.ts)

states.description: alive and not escaped: the reign goes on, month by month.
escaped = true: away by helicopter, or over the mountains on foot.

transitions.guard: the helicopter was bought and starts
no helicopter, or it fails to start

transitions.trigger: revolution(): fleeing, by choice or after choosing a helper who won't help
transitions.guard: the helicopter starts, or the escape on foot isn't caught

transitions.trigger: revolution(): fleeing on foot, or choosing a helper who won't help

transitions.action: Punish the rebels if asked; afterVictory() pauses plots for two months.
